title: The Last Donut
logline:
A bright supermarket, late afternoon.
Two old rivals in wheelchairs spot the LAST donut at the bakery counter.
They race down the aisle for it.
A small kid takes it first.

chars.name: AL
chars.look: Thin old man, long nose, white mustache

chars.name: ROSE
chars.look: Round old woman, big purple glasses, silver curls
chars.prop: Rides a pink wheelchair with a basket

chars.name: THE KID
chars.look: Small child with a blond bowl cut

location:
Inside a bright supermarket.
One long aisle leads to the bakery counter.
ONE donut sits on a glass stand on the counter.
blocking:
AL always on FRAME LEFT, ROSE on FRAME RIGHT.
The kid enters from the RIGHT at the counter.
scale:
The kid's head reaches their shoulders.
The donut is the size of a fist.
continuity:
AL's bathrobe stays RED.
ROSE's cardigan stays GREEN.
Only ONE donut in the whole film.
The floor is shiny white tile.
firstFrame:
Wide view down the aisle.
The donut glows on the counter far away.
textLock: A sign above the counter reads exactly "BAKERY"

plates.name: Aisle
plates.desc: The long aisle seen from its start, shelves on both sides, the bakery counter far away
Low view of the aisle floor, shiny tiles, shelves rising on both sides

plates.name: Bakery counter

shots.act:
The aisle. The donut on the counter.
AL and ROSE roll in from both sides.

shots.act: They race down the aisle, wheels sparking.

Both reach for the donut.
The kid takes it first.
shots.end: The kid holds the donut, AL and ROSE frozen with arms out
